gamerule.brainageserverutils.disable_ite: Using an item or firing ammunition does not use it up. Fired arrows cannot be picked up, so they are not duplicated.
gamerule.brainageserverutils.disable_buc: Filling a bucket, bottle or other container keeps the empty one as well.
gamerule.brainageserverutils.instant_con: Food, drinks and other consumables are used in one tick.
gamerule.brainageserverutils.disable_hun: Hunger stays full and saturation does not drain.
gamerule.brainageserverutils.free_enchan: Enchanting tables and anvils cost no levels and need none. Lapis and anvil materials are still used.
gamerule.brainageserverutils.disable_too: Anvil costs of 40 levels or more are capped at 39 instead of being refused as Too Expensive. Stacked items are still refused.
gamerule.brainageserverutils.disable_ite: Removes item cooldowns such as ender pearls and wind charges, and axes no longer disable shields.
